freeze_semantics.meaning: The evaluator code and policy identity to be used for the next valid H1 are bound to the exact repository tree at implementation_freeze_commit before any external H1 feature package is released.
does_not_mean: the policy is a validated bot detector

freeze_semantics.mutation_rule: Any evaluator implementation change after an H1 feature package is sealed against this freeze creates a different policy version and cannot be substituted into that sealed H1.
freeze_semantics.history_rule: Preserve this certificate unchanged. A future evaluator version receives a new freeze certificate rather than overwriting this identity.
